description: Find CBS StatLine datasets by keyword (matched against title). Returns table id, title, period and language. Table ids ending in "eng"/"ENG" have English labels; others are Dutch.

english_only.description: If true, only return English-language tables (id ends in "eng"). Default false.

keyword.description: Search term matched in the table title, e.g. "population", "energy", "wages".

name: search_tables
